name: Kallang Bend
summary: Bend of the Kallang River toward Stadium / Geylang Bahru — event-day energy, mixed housing, and ActiveSG-adjacent recreation as the lifestyle hook.
body: Kallang Bend is the shortlist when stadium-adjacent recreation and river-edge walks matter more than quiet landed texture. The pocket sits on the Kallang / Stadium / Geylang Bahru bend; housing mixes newer condos, older walk-ups, and selective HDB edges. Expats land here for ActiveSG catchment and EWL/DTL optionality without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: event-day crowd spikes, boom-gate queues when visitor QR fails, and fencing / bowling programme release races. Compare with Potong Pasir Fringe for quieter NEL living, Lavender North for mid-town EWL, and Kallang Wave when sports-hub gravity dominates.
bestFor: households who will use ActiveSG fencing / lanes weekly
